authority.loreFinding: Imperial collective Divine worship and the Nord Old Ways or Imperialized Divines alternatives are lore-supported. Only one Nord baseline is active at a time.
authority.precedence: This contract supersedes civic-service-count gating, the Old-Ways-only Nord reward resolver, and any roster that omits the locked Old Ways members below.

representation.activeState: PATRON_STATE_BROAD plus matching origin and Nord baseline where applicable

shared.activeEffectsConvention: The spell FULL is '<family> - <public band>'; each child MGEF FULL is its concise mechanical effect name. Internal Seeker identifiers remain compatibility-only and never appear to the player.
shared.deityScoring: Every deity receives its own ordinary signed piety independently of the broad pool.

logicalEventAggregation.positiveRule: Use the strongest applied positive eligible deity delta.
logicalEventAggregation.negativeRule: If no eligible positive delta exists, use the most severe applied eligible negative delta.
logicalEventAggregation.deltaStage: post gain pipeline, stance, curse, and mode scaling

shared.gainEligibility: Only the pool matching the active origin and broad baseline receives event gains.
shared.suppressedPersistence: Pool value persists while inactive or committed.

decay.activityDefinition: Any nonzero eligible signed pool event counts as activity for that devotional day; a negative event already reduces standing through signed scratch and does not also receive an inactivity tick. Only positive events reset the two-day last-gain grace.

shared.signalOverlap: A single authentic act may separately satisfy a cultural substrate and a deity signal, but neither lane fabricates the other lane's credit.

conditional.Talos: Eligible only after explicit Talos stance, prayer, or defiance unlock.

tier1.name: Old Ways - Observant
tier1.effects: Preserve the shipped Stamina effect packet; child MGEF FULL is Fortify Stamina.

tier2.name: Old Ways - Faithful
tier2.effects: Preserve the shipped Stamina plus Frost Resistance effect packet.

rewardFamily.recordPolicy: Use distinct Nord records; never reuse the Imperial SPEL or MGEF records.

nordParity.forbiddenDifference: One baseline may not depend only on shared cross-race deity signals while the other has a separate reachable broad reward implementation.

acceptance: grant focused T2 when deity piety is 50-84
grant focused T3 at 85 or above
patronTransition.focusedT1: Compatibility artifact only; never granted to Imperial or Nord focused patrons.
patronTransition.below50: Commitment persists, but the focused boon is suspended until piety recovers to 50.

proofBoundary.authority: This JSON and reconciled design documentation.
proofBoundary.staticReadback: Manager source, direct houseCARL record and VMAD/FormList readback, verifier and adversary audits.
proofBoundary.runtimeRoute: Counted event aggregation, dawn fold, decay, baseline, and transition traces.
proofBoundary.manualPlayerSurface: Active Effects, Survey, Prisma, Book of Days, save/load, and stack-legibility observation.
proofBoundary.releaseClaim: Forbidden until all earlier buckets pass for both Nord baselines and Imperial.
